candidateSkills.name: activate-features
candidateSkills.description: One-shot activation of all automatic Codex features -- hooks, crons, health checks, telemetry. Run once per fresh setup.

candidateSkills.name: checkpoint
candidateSkills.description: Create a named context checkpoint before destructive operations or after milestone completion. Saves current state summary.

candidateSkills.name: codebase-memory-exploring
candidateSkills.description: Codebase knowledge graph expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user explores code, searches for functions/classes/routes, asks about architecture, or needs codebase orientation. Do not use Grep, Glob, or file search directly — use codebase-memory-mcp search_graph and get_architecture first.

candidateSkills.name: codebase-memory-quality
candidateSkills.description: Code quality analysis expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user asks about dead code, unused functions, complexity, refactor candidates, or cleanup opportunities. Do not search files manually — use codebase-memory-mcp search_graph with degree filters first.

candidateSkills.name: codebase-memory-reference
candidateSkills.description: Codebase-memory-mcp reference guide. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user asks about MCP tools, graph queries, Cypher syntax, edge types, or how to use the knowledge graph. Do not guess tool parameters — load this reference first.

candidateSkills.name: codebase-memory-tracing
candidateSkills.description: Call chain and dependency expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user asks who calls a function, what a function calls, needs impact analysis, or traces dependencies. Do not grep for function names directly — use codebase-memory-mcp trace_call_path first.

candidateSkills.name: context-budget
candidateSkills.description: Monitor context window pressure, recommend compaction, track critical fact survival rate.

candidateSkills.name: dispatch-format
candidateSkills.description: Format PRISM output for Dispatch (phone) consumption. Compact, emoji-free, 1-line summaries with expandable details.

candidateSkills.name: feature-matrix
candidateSkills.description: Show which Codex features are active, which should be activated, and when each triggers automatically.

candidateSkills.name: memory-prune
candidateSkills.description: Analyze and prune stale memory entries. Checks referenced files still exist, archives old entries, keeps MEMORY.md under 180 lines.

candidateSkills.name: model-router
candidateSkills.description: "Recommend optimal Codex model tier (haiku/sonnet/opus) for a given task based on historical success rates and cost efficiency."

candidateSkills.name: prism-review
candidateSkills.description: Run PRISM-specific code review on recent changes. Dispatches physics, wiring, and test review agents in parallel.
